steps.title: Verify the test environment pipeline is green in GitHub Actions
steps.sop: The DevOps Engineer is done when the test environment is reachable with a passing pipeline.
steps.verify: Checker opens the test pipeline in GitHub Actions and confirms the latest run is green.

steps.title: Verify the staging environment pipeline is green in GitHub Actions
steps.sop: The DevOps Engineer is done when the staging environment is reachable with a passing pipeline.
steps.verify: Checker opens the staging pipeline in GitHub Actions and confirms the latest run is green.

steps.title: Register the environment configuration items in CMDB
steps.sop: The DevOps Engineer is done when dev, test and staging CIs exist in the CMDB.
steps.verify: Checker searches the CMDB and confirms a CI record exists for each environment.

steps.title: Tick every field on the readiness checklist in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when no checklist field on the mobilization page is unticked.
steps.verify: Checker opens the mobilization-readiness page in Confluence and confirms every field is ticked.

steps.title: Reconcile the required roles to the confirmed assignments in Confluence
steps.sop: The Scrum Master is done when required and confirmed counts match with 0 gaps at kickoff.
steps.verify: Checker compares the two counts on the readiness page in Confluence and confirms they are equal.

steps.title: Log each gap as a Mobilization-Blocker item in Jira
steps.sop: The Scrum Master is done when every blocker carries an owner and a target date.
steps.verify: Checker opens each Mobilization-Blocker in Jira and confirms owner plus target date are set.

steps.title: Escalate blockers older than 5 business days to the Resource Manager in Jira
steps.sop: The Scrum Master escalates each aged blocker to the Resource Manager or PMO.
steps.verify: Checker filters aged blockers in Jira and confirms each carries an escalation record.

steps.title: Record the Scrum Master sign-off on the readiness page in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when the Scrum Master sign-off is recorded before Sprint 1.
steps.verify: Checker confirms the Scrum Master sign-off is present on the readiness page in Confluence.

steps.title: List the quarterly knowledge gaps on the KM plan in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when every identified gap for the quarter appears on the plan.
steps.verify: Checker opens the KM plan in Confluence and confirms the quarter gap list is populated.

steps.title: Assign a named SME to each planned contribution in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when no KM board card lacks an SME author.
steps.verify: Checker inspects each KM card in Jira and confirms the SME author field is populated.

steps.title: Name the reviewer on each contribution card in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when every card names its reviewer.
steps.verify: Checker inspects each KM card in Jira and confirms the reviewer field is populated.

steps.title: Record the target page on each contribution card in Jira
steps.sop: The Backend Developer is done when every card names its target Confluence page or space.
steps.verify: Checker inspects each KM card in Jira and confirms the target page field is populated.

steps.title: Set the due date on each contribution card in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when no card lacks a due date.
steps.verify: Checker inspects each KM card in Jira and confirms the due date is set.

steps.title: Publish each contribution to its target space in Confluence
steps.sop: The UI Developer is done when every completed contribution is live on its target page.
steps.verify: Checker opens each target page in Confluence and confirms the contribution content is published.

steps.title: Record the peer review on each published page in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when no published page lacks a named reviewer sign-off.
steps.verify: Checker reads the version history in Confluence and confirms each page shows a reviewer sign-off.

steps.title: Block the Done status on cards missing the page link in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when the board rule prevents Done without link and reviewer sign-off.
steps.verify: Checker attempts to close a linkless card in Jira and confirms the board rule blocks the transition.

steps.title: Link each published page from the KM index in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when the index references every published contribution.
steps.verify: Checker opens the KM index in Confluence and confirms each published page is linked.

steps.title: Reconcile the planned count to the captured totals in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when planned equals captured plus carried-over plus dropped.
steps.verify: Checker sums the card states in Jira and confirms 0 items sit assigned past due at quarter close.

steps.title: Re-assign contributions an SME cannot complete in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer records a disposition note and escalates after 2 unresolved quarters.
steps.verify: Checker opens each deferred card in Jira and confirms the disposition note plus new assignee.

steps.title: Raise an SDLC-Exception for business-critical gaps in Jira
steps.sop: The Software Engineer files the exception with a 10-business-day remediation SLA.
steps.verify: Checker opens each exception in Jira and confirms the 10-day SLA is recorded.

steps.title: Record the Tech Lead sign-off on the KM plan in Confluence
steps.sop: The Software Engineer is done when at least 90 percent capture is met and the sign-off is recorded.
steps.verify: Checker confirms the Tech Lead sign-off is present on the KM plan in Confluence.
